knowledgeRules.sourcePriority: Supplied PDF is baseline. Live store system for variant prices, stock, offers, pincode delivery eligibility. Marketing content is not a price list. Do not create numerical firmness ratings from decorative dots.
knowledgeRules.boundaries: Separate facts explicitly in source, explanations/tentative recommendations, and unknown details requiring confirmation. Never promise medical cures or spinal treatment.
knowledgeRules.layerPlaceholder: All 8 pages contain exact-layer placeholders. Exact internal layer sequence, density, and thickness need team confirmation.
knowledgeRules.measuringSequence: Inside length of bed × inside width of bed × required mattress height. 1 foot = 12 inches; 1 inch = 2.54 cm.

products.name: LORA CLOUD 7™
products.audience: Sleepers who prefer a softer, cushioned feel
products.customerExplanation: A starting point for someone who wants a softer surface with balanced support. Its stated 7-inch profile is useful when checking the overall height of the bed.
products.restrictions: Do not infer that '7' means seven zones. Do not call it 8-inch, 10-year warranty, or certified spinal treatment.

products.name: LORA CLOUD ORTHO™
products.audience: Sleepers wanting cushioning with balanced support (preferring Medium feel over Cloud 7's Medium-Soft)
products.customerExplanation: Consider this when you want cushioning but prefer the medium comfort category rather than Cloud 7's medium-soft category.
products.restrictions: Do not infer pain treatment or clinical approval from 'Ortho'. Do not assume it is an extra-hard mattress.

products.name: LORA PLUSH™
products.audience: People who love a softer, cosier mattress feel
products.customerExplanation: A useful first option when softness is the main preference. Compare with Cloud 7 if the shopper wants plush/soft versus medium-soft.
products.restrictions: Do not invent organic latex, cashmere fabric, or unconfirmed materials.

products.name: LORA ORTHO HYBRID™
products.audience: Sleepers looking for stronger support with responsive comfort
products.customerExplanation: Shortlist for a customer who prefers a medium-firm feel rather than a plush surface. The exact hybrid components are not listed in this reference.
products.restrictions: Do not infer that 'hybrid' necessarily confirms pocket springs in this model.

products.name: LORA ORTHO LATEX™
products.audience: Sleepers who prefer responsive latex comfort with stronger support
products.customerExplanation: Shortlist when the customer specifically prefers latex comfort and a medium-firm feel.
products.restrictions: Do not translate marketing phrase 'natural comfort' into '100% organic natural latex'.

products.name: LORA COMFORT CORE™
products.audience: Sleepers looking for dependable everyday comfort
products.customerExplanation: A medium-feel pillow-top option for someone seeking balanced everyday comfort. 'Everyday' does not establish it as lowest-priced.
products.restrictions: Do not describe as reversible, dual-sided, or medium-soft on one side without approval.

products.name: LORA POCKET LUXE™
products.type: Pocket support technology with premium pillow-top comfort
products.audience: Couples and people seeking premium independent support with reduced motion transfer
products.customerExplanation: The clearest source-backed starting point when partner movement is the main concern.
products.restrictions: Never promise zero disturbance or claim a 1,200-spring count from this source.

products.name: LORA HYBRID FUSION™
products.audience: Sleepers wanting advanced multi-layer comfort and stronger support
products.customerExplanation: Shortlist when the shopper wants a medium-firm model combining the three listed foam materials. It has the longest stated warranty (15 years).
products.restrictions: Do not infer seven-zone pocket springs, cooling PCM fabric, or an all-latex construction.

comparisonRules.summary: Both have Eurotop positioning. Cloud 7 is Medium-Soft, 7-inch profile, 3-year warranty. Cloud Ortho is Medium, 9-inch profile, 5-year warranty.
Cloud 7 is Medium-Soft Eurotop (7-inch, 3-year warranty). Lora Plush is Plush/Soft Pillow-Top (5-year warranty, height unconfirmed).
Both are Medium feel. Cloud Ortho is 9-inch Eurotop with 5-year warranty. Comfort Core is Pillow-Top with 10-year warranty (height unconfirmed).
Both are Pillow-Top models. Plush is Plush/Soft with 5-year warranty; Comfort Core is Medium feel with 10-year warranty.
Both are Medium-Firm. Ortho Hybrid has responsive hybrid positioning and a 10-year warranty; Ortho Latex explicitly features latex comfort and a 12-year warranty.
Both are Medium-Firm. Ortho Latex highlights latex comfort with 12-year warranty. Hybrid Fusion explicitly combines Natural Latex Foam, Memory Foam, and Orthopedic Foam with a 15-year warranty.

Both are Medium feel and carry 10-year warranties. Pocket Luxe specifically highlights independent pocket support and reduced partner disturbance; Comfort Core highlights balanced everyday pillow-top comfort.
Both are Medium-Firm. Ortho Hybrid carries a 10-year warranty and unspecified hybrid composition. Hybrid Fusion carries a 15-year warranty and 3 named foam materials.
